name: Hallow Hearts
source:
It's Halloween night and your friends invite you out to a local festival just a few towns away. You arrive to be greeted by the landlord of the estate. You wonder how someone so young owns so much land? 

Before you could question it, you find your friends bailing on you at the last minute. Ouch… You could always leave, but where’s the fun in that? You decide to press on and enjoy the night while it's still young!

[From [url=https://sleepi-studios.itch.io/hallow-hearts]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
万圣节之夜，你的朋友邀请你参加几个城镇外的当地节日。你到达时会受到庄园房东的欢迎。你想知道这么年轻的人怎么拥有这么多土地？

在你提出质疑之前，你发现你的朋友在最后一刻抛弃了你。哎哟……你可以随时离开，但那有什么乐趣呢？你决定趁这还年轻的时候继续前进并享受这个夜晚！

[来自[url=https://sleepi-studios.itch.io/hallow-hearts]Itch.io[/url]]
